matches.description: Watch Barracas Central vs Banfield highlights and goals from Argentine Primera División on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 2, 2026. Barracas Central and Banfield locked horns in a gritty Liga Profesional Argentina encounter that tested the endurance and tactical discipline of both squads until the very final whistle. The match provided a display of early efficiency followed by a grueling tactical battle that kept the spectators on the edge of their seats throughout the evening. Explosive Start at Barracas On the evening of May 2, 2026 , the Liga Profesional Argentina delivered a contest of contrasting halves that began with immediate fireworks. The match burst into life within the opening minutes as Banfield sought to impose their authority away from home. In the 8th minute, Santiago Lopez turned creator, delivering a precise ball that found Tiziano Perrotta in a dangerous position. Perrotta made no mistake with the chance , clinical in his execution to put the visitors ahead and silence the home crowd. However, the lead proved to be fragile. Barracas Central responded with admirable resilience, refusing to let the early setback dictate the narrative of the first half . Their persistence paid off in the 16th minute when Nicolas Demartini found the back of the net with a well-timed strike. The equalizer restored parity and shifted the momentum, leaving both sides to head into the tunnel at halftime with everything still to play for after an intense opening 45 minutes. Tactical Stalemate and Personnel Changes As the second half got underway, the high-octane energy of the opening period gave way to a more calculated and cagey affair. Managers on both sides looked to their benches to break the deadlock. Barracas Central made the first move, introducing Dardo Federico Miloc for Enzo Taborda at the restart. As the clock ticked past the hour mark, a flurry of tactical changes followed. Banfield introduced Lautaro Gomez and later Jhonatan Candia , while the home side brought on the likes of Gonzalo Maroni and Lisandro Pinero to freshen up the midfield and attack. The most significant tactical shift occurred in the 79th minute, a window that saw four simultaneous substitutions for the visiting side. Among those entering the fray were Santiago Daniele and Lucas Emanuel Gamba . While the game became increasingly physical—highlighted by a yellow card for Damian Alberto Martinez in the 89th minute—it appeared as though the tactical reshuffling from both managers would result in a shared point. Late Drama Secures the Points Just as the fourth official signaled for stoppage time, the definitive moment of the evening arrived to stun the home fans. In the 91st minute, the substitute Santiago Daniele proved his worth by providing a pinpoint assist into the heart of the area. Santiago Lopez , who had already played a vital role in the opening goal , rose to the occasion once more. He latched onto the pass and steered his effort home to reclaim the lead for Banfield in dramatic fashion. Despite the late blow, Barracas Central attempted a desperate final surge, but the organized Banfield defense held firm through five minutes of added time. When the referee finally blew the whistle at 90+5, it confirmed a hard-fought away victory for the Taladro, fueled by the clinical late-game heroics of Lopez .
